graph.name: Prepare a scene recap
graph.description:
Select and summarize the context needed to resume a scene without turning a recap into new canon.

Lesson: Protect unresolved facts, compress flexible history when needed, then plan resumption. Derived recap is not new canon.

Limitations: Compression plus planning is at most two auxiliary calls. Summaries can omit or misstate facts; inspect omissions. This does not commit a recap to memory.

Opening installs an unassigned copy. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Pre: at most 2 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Switch Compress to Select; compare preservation reports and request count.
Lower Target to 600 with pins retained; inspect protected-budget failure rather than silent loss.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Recent context: The ferry is delayed, Rin is checking the harbor, and Mira still has Sol's unopened letter.

Resumption brief: Keep the delayed ferry and unopened letter active. Resume with the current scene; do not assume Rin has returned.

Prepare history: Exact case-sensitive pins fail if absent/over-budget. Compression Analysis ≤1 when needed.

Plan resumption: Analysis ≤2, unbound. Context target 1500; compression cap 2048; plan cap 2048; Guidance budget 520. Reasoning tokens may consume the completion cap; inspect truncation and change it manually before a fresh run.

No capture: Inspect originals/omissions for summary errors. Pre guidance is not canon/memory; opening calls no provider.

History to resume (pre-scene)
Purpose: Read bounded resumption history.
Fixture: Fixture: “The ferry is delayed.” “Rin is checking the harbor.” “Mira still has Sol’s unopened letter.” Include the exact configured pins in test context.
Inspect: Check original IDs/source omissions.

Keep the ferry and letter intact (pre-compact)
Purpose: Protect exact facts and compress flexibly.
Inspect: Check retained/removed/summarized/input-omitted IDs.

Output tokens includes visible text and any reasoning tokens counted by the provider. A truncated result is discarded; inspect the error, then manually raise the cap and rerun. No automatic retry occurs.

Resume the unresolved moment (pre-plan)
Purpose: Propose a brief resumption plan.
Inspect: Compare plan to originals/derived summary.

Output tokens includes visible text and any reasoning tokens counted by the provider. A truncated result is discarded; inspect the error, then manually raise the cap and rerun. No automatic retry occurs.

Short return-to-scene brief (pre-output)
Purpose: Expose a separately bounded brief.
Inspect: Check “unopened”/Rin still away.

pre-compact.title: Smart Compactor
pre-compact.alias: Keep the ferry and letter intact
pre-compact.purpose: Summarize only the supplied historical chunk. Purpose keywords are not facts; do not import recent facts absent from that chunk. Keep presence clear; plans/guesses are not completed events.

pre-plan.title: Response Plan
pre-plan.instructions: Brief: established now, unresolved, optional next beat. Keep the unopened letter sealed. Rin's departure does not prove arrival or progress. Establish current facts only from supplied sources. Mark summaries/report conflicts. No offscreen invention, skipped player choice or private state. Do not invent existing travelers or weather.
